head: CrowCards flashcard app with no subscription and no account
dek: CrowCards is a flashcard app for iPhone and iPad that you buy once for 3.99 dollars: no account, no login and no subscription. It was #30 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on November 14.
details: Each card gets a score from 0 to 10 as you rate it, and the cards you struggle with come back first. There are four modes: flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes with wrong answers that look plausible, Mix and Match, and a five-minute Chaos Mode that mixes all three. Decks can be shared with a QR code and imported or exported through iCloud Drive, Google Drive or OneDrive. It's a rebuild of the maker's older EasyCards app, by Joseph Flanigan.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad (iOS 16.4 or later); 3.99 dollars once
means: If you're tired of study apps that want a monthly fee, CrowCards is a one-time purchase and keeps your decks on your device.
todo: Bring your existing decks in with the import option; the maker says photo flashcards and note scanning are being worked on.
